command.name: DVI Forward Search
command.exe:code: [ -f medit-env.sh ] && . medit-env.sh doc="${LATEX_MASTER:-$DOC}" doc_base=`basename "$doc" .tex` if (which kdvi > /dev/null); then kdvi --unique file:"$doc_base.dvi"#src:"$LINE$DOC" && \ dcop `dcopfind -a 'kviewshell-*'` kdvi-mainwindow#1 hide && \ dcop `dcopfind -a 'kviewshell-*'` kdvi-mainwindow#1 show else xdg-open "$doc_base.dvi" fi
